findings.summary: Spec P7 is unmet on its own reported evidence. P7 requires the full `npx vitest run` to be truly green in a clean environment and requires BOTH final counts to be no lower than the main 4312cae baseline of 25 files / 458 tests. The dev-note's pasted tail reports 'Test Files 16 passed | 10 failed (26)' and 'Tests 325 passed | 4 failed (329)' — i.e. a FAIL section is present and the test count 329 is 129 below the 458 baseline. The dev-note then substitutes a weaker claim, '新增文件数不低于基线' (file count 26 >= 25), which silently drops the test-count half of the criterion; spec §5 item 4 explicitly forbids explaining away a test-count gap. Missing `yaml`/`vite-node` is an uninstalled declared devDependency, not one of the four env vars P7 defines as 'clean', so it does not exempt the run. The suite was therefore never demonstrated green.

Because 10 test files never collected, the regression surface of the very module this package rewrote is unverified. test/a10c-writebudget.test.ts imports `runWrite` from ../src/tick-run and drives it at lines 180/190/274, yet it is one of the 9 files that failed on the `yaml` import and thus contributed 0 tests. This change altered `applyTriageBatch`'s signature (added the `runId` parameter) and widened `spawnTriage`'s return type to `{ decisions, runId }`, so write-budget and other tick-run consumers could regress with no signal. Verified-green coverage of the touched module is a precondition, not a formality.

The dev-note's account of the 4 failing tests is self-contradictory and unattributed, which spec §5 item 5 forbids ('不得编造失败现象'). It asserts the failures are '继承的预存失败，非本包引入' and '4 个预存失败在基线也存在', but the same section states the baseline at main 4312cae is 458 tests passing — a green baseline cannot contain 4 pre-existing failures. No failing test name, file, or assertion is cited, so the claim cannot be checked and the failures are not attributed to any cause.

The retry-policy justification cites the wrong source location. The dev-note says the generate-side `readBody` 30x1s loop it copies lives at `src/tick-run.ts` 行 1303–1312; the actual `readBody` retry loop is at src/tick-run.ts:1283-1292, while 1303-1312 is `spawnAnchorCheck`'s allowed-root check and evidence read. The chosen 30x1s value itself does match the generate side and is adequately reasoned.

P8's restore evidence is stated as an inference rather than a measurement. The text reads '仅 src/tick-run.ts 有改动，逐一还原即可清空 diff' — a prediction that reverting will clear the diff — instead of reporting the observed `git status --porcelain` output after all four mutations were restored. P8 requires the post-restore porcelain status to be empty as measured fact.

The product change and the mutation-matrix reachability defects from the prior Final review are genuinely resolved, and this should not be re-litigated in rework. `readTriageResult` (src/tick-inspect.ts:350-356) re-reads the channel on every call; the production default `readResult` at src/tick-run.ts:1521-1530 uses it with 30x1s retries, distinguishes `[]` from `null`, and throws naming the runId. Q1 is now observable via the injection-free production test (test/g5-triage-read.test.ts:656-715, casCount===2 with the result appearing only on the 2nd board:agent-runs read), Q2 via test/g5-triage-read.test.ts:262-311, Q3 via test/g5-triage-read.test.ts:352-399, and Q4 via test/g5-triage-read.test.ts:441-492. P1-P6 are satisfied on production-assembled deps; only the P7/P8 evidence gates block approval.

The dev-note `input_commit` is correct and must not be 'fixed'. It records c33bb08043e0e3ee52317807a3cbd4ff611e4cdd, which is exactly the `input_commit` in this attempt's implement handoff (.dev-dispatch/handoffs/attempt_01KZM5KAQA3RT6RWV94XPSQ8YJ/implement.json), satisfying spec §5 item 4. The Continuous review's minor finding compared this field against 25f17ef0f6b577638fdbd287eecc71d34d34ed34, which is the I-stage product handoff rather than the dispatch input_commit, so that finding was based on the wrong reference value.
